data.content_ref: inline:The proposed mechanism is described at such a high level of abstraction ('acceptance-driven verification loop where a claim is validated by checking it against an independently generated or specified instance') that it could apply to virtually any testing or verification process. No specific, distinguishing characteristics of 'mutation-testing' (SRC_005) or 'test definitions' (SRC_001) are identified to justify this relation. A summary of generic properties common to most software testing does not constitute a substantive shared mechanism.
